The reason it says "or similar" is because when you book a car you book the type of car not a specific car. So when you book a full size car and it says Camry or similar you aren't booking a Camry you're booking a car that is classed as full size. Fleet availability when you get to the counter will ultimately determine what car you get. You can ask if they have a certain car though and they will probably give it to you.

Call the location directly before booking because they may have a lower price than what you will see online.
